doc.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Rap as an oxymoron
summary: Carter says there is rap but no rap music, as the beat appeals to kids.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Okay. I’ll continue here with a little digression again. Someone just brought up the I guess we could call it an oxymoron, maybe, of rap music.

What, what? [Berger laughs.] I wouldn’t expect you to say that. There’s no such thing, as far as I’m concerned, as rap music. There is rap, and much of it is quite good, you know. But I’ve yet to hear one with any music to it. The beat, rhythm is there. I think that’s what’s very, very attractive to the kids. But rap music, as you say, that is an oxymoron.
